segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Hello, what seems to be the problem?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doctor, mujhe 3 days se fever hai and body ache bhi ho raha hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Do you have cough or vomiting?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: No doctor, vomiting nahi hui. Bas weakness hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Okay, your temperature is 101 F. It could be a viral fever.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Which medicine should I take, doctor?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Main Paracetamol 500 mg prescribe kar raha hoon. Take it according to the prescribed instructions.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Do I need any tests?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: CBC test karwa lijiye. Drink plenty of fluids and come back if the fever persists.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Good morning. Are you here for your diabetes check-up?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Yes doctor, mujhe 4 years se diabetes hai. Aajkal I feel very thirsty.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Which medicine are you currently taking?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Main Metformin 500 mg twice daily leta hoon.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Your fasting blood glucose is 156 mg/dL. We should check your HbA1c.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Should I change my medicine?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Abhi medicine change nahi karenge. Report dekhne ke baad decide karenge.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Okay doctor, when should I return?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: HbA1c test karwa lijiye and come back in one week.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Hi, what symptoms are you experiencing?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doctor, khana khane ke baad stomach mein burning hoti hai. It has been happening for 3 days.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Do you have vomiting or nausea?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Nahi doctor, vomiting nahi hui, but khatti dakaar aati hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: It could be acidity. Have you taken any medication?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: No doctor, abhi tak koi medicine nahi li.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Main Omeprazole 20 mg prescribe kar raha hoon, once daily before breakfast.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Should I avoid anything?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Avoid spicy food and come for a follow-up if symptoms continue.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Hello, what problem are you facing?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doctor, mujhe 4 days se cold hai, dry cough aur sore throat bhi hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Do you have fever or difficulty breathing?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Fever bhi hai, kal temperature 100 F tha. Breathing mein koi problem nahi hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Okay, let me check your temperature and throat. Your temperature is 100.4 F. Throat mein inflammation hai aur examination ke basis par bacterial throat infection lag raha hai.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doctor, what medicines do I need?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Main Amoxicillin 500 mg, din mein 3 baar, 5 days ke liye prescribe kar raha hoon. Saath mein Paracetamol 500 mg fever ke liye prescribe kar raha hoon, as directed.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Should I complete the full course?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Yes, antibiotic prescribed duration tak lijiye. Fluids pijiye aur rest kariye.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Okay doctor, when should I come back?

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Agar 48-72 hours mein improvement nahi hota, ya breathing difficulty hoti hai, toh promptly review karaiye.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Kya problem hai?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doctor, kal se vomiting aur loose motions ho rahe hain. Bahut weakness aur chakkar aa rahe hain.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Paani pee paa rahe ho? Fever hai?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Paani peete hi nausea hota hai. Fever nahi hai.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Aapko dehydration ho sakta hai. BP check karte hain. ORS small sips mein lijiye. Severe dehydration hua toh IV fluids dene pad sakte hain.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Okay doctor.
